research_goal: Improve contribution attribution, practical baselines and deployment portability for TPDS without outcome-driven repetition

RTX_R1_natural.reference: unchanged current C1024 original R, qualified new hybrids
RTX_R1_natural.gate: Distinct qualified implementations and an unanswered natural-workload question; skip when aligned paths alias or merely repeat PR186/190

RTX_R1_structural.scope: known-token append diagnostics, not natural requests

RTX_R2_optional.baseline_policy: All qualified distinct target-only factorial strategies; omission only by documented source/native-trace/cost equivalence or native inapplicability before R2 outcomes
RTX_R2_optional.order_design: Williams4 when four arms; predeclared four cyclic rows for five/six arms, not fully balanced
RTX_R2_optional.primary_comparisons: L_D4 against every included fixed target-only arm, family-adjusted; matched-residency sensitivity separate

B570_B1.scope: new capacity reference fixed before candidate; no draft-profit panel

proposed_all_stage_ceilings.note: Include qualification/reference/warmups/failures; limits are not targets. Actual host binding and reservation required.

local_original_host_execution: Requested via executing-agent handoff after binding/qualification; this authoring session runs no GPU
runtime_request_lifecycle: Reuse platform supervisor/ledger; this package does not create a second general runner
statistics_dependency: NumPy for analysis; Python >=3.11 for tools
build_freeze_required: Complete compiler dependency closure, generated/config/response files, compiler/link options, tools/link inputs and actual modules after qualification before performance
cost_record_policy: Unknown/null and NOT_EXECUTED distinct; complete totals require declared root/session or request coverage; partial sums named observed_sum_s
structural_cost_policy: Native append-only clock after valid state preparation, never service fallback; clean observer scope verified
